gloss: to run into; to escape into; to take refuge in

definitions.gloss: to run into; to escape into; to take refuge in
definitions.explanation: to flee into an enclosed space or location for shelter or safety

examples.english: It started raining so I ducked into a shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いて→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧⟦{茂|しげ}み→茂み：24292_shigemi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逃|に}げ{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The cat got startled and ran into the bushes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われて→追う：02016_ou⟧⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逃|に}げ{込|こ}んだ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{行|い}き{止|ど}まり→行き止まり：08167_ikidomari⟧だった。
examples.english: The thief was chased by police and ran into an alley, but it was a dead end.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ (to escape) with ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ component adds the nuance of entering or going deep into a space. Can be used both for literal physical escape and for casual situations like ducking out of rain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逃|に}げ{込|こ}む: to run into a building
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逃|に}げ{込|こ}む: to escape into a room
- ⟦{茂|しげ}み→茂み：24292_shigemi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逃|に}げ{込|こ}む: to dart into the bushes
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逃|に}げ{込|こ}む: to take refuge in a safe place

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧: to escape, to flee — general fleeing without specifying a destination
- ⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}む→駆け込む：06112_kakekomu⟧: to rush into — emphasizes speed of entry rather than escape
- ⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}む→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧: to jump into — physical leaping into a space
- ⟦{逃|に}げ{出|だ}す→逃げ出す：06041_nigedasu⟧: to run away from — emphasizes leaving rather than entering a refuge

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. The destination is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.
